newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares fall on U.S. rate worries.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares fall on U.S. rate worries.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Swedish shares ended lower on Thursday in a nervous market after U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan opened the way for possible rate hikes at the Federal Open Market Committe (FOMC) meeting on Tuesday.
* Stockholm general index falls 1.66 percent at 2,627.69
* The sharp downturn pulled many blue chips along, including telecoms group Ericsson and drugs major Astra.
* Nordbanken, appliance maker Electrolux and forestry group MoDo also belonged to losers.
